title: Potato, mushroom and kale hash with eggs

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Potatoes, onion, mushrooms, kale, eggs, oil, thyme and paprika are all plain home ingredients.

supermarket.reason: Every ingredient is an everyday, cheap item at Tesco or similar.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a knife, a board and a large lidded frying pan, with simple frying technique.

works.reason: The quantities suit four, 1cm cubes fried for 15 minutes with frequent turning will cook through, and the lid sets the eggs in 4 minutes.

honest_times.reason: At 15 minutes prep plus 25 minutes cook, this 40-minute breakfast is not quick, and the 15-minute potato fry 'turning often' is active work rather than unattended cook time.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning is used, and nothing unlisted apart from water appears in the steps.

seasonal_feel.reason: A hot potato hash with kale suits a cold late-January morning, and the potatoes are the heart of the dish.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are plain, clear British English that a beginner can follow.

hearty_healthy.reason: Potatoes, vegetables and eggs make a filling, balanced breakfast a family would want again.
